title: [Downstream] frontend: new accessibility violation image-alt
description:
Downstream's frontend check on !6 found this on the head build (f2ba5450482c) and not on the base build (7f2473276ae8). Started by @AlphaTechini.

**Where it shows up**

- `home_shows_header`: image-alt at `img` (Images must have alternative text)
- `explore_shows_header`: image-alt at `img` (Images must have alternative text)
- `repo_page_shows_header`: image-alt at `img` (Images must have alternative text)

Pages were rendered in happy-dom with the app's own JavaScript, three times: base twice, then head. A check that moved between the two base runs is withheld, not reported here.

**Frontend files changed**

- `internal/web/templates/layout.html`

Not checked: color-contrast, visual layout, real paint/CPU timing.

**Likely cause**

Likely the new img element added to the header in layout.html has no alt attribute, so every page that uses the layout gets an image without alternative text.

**Fix options**

1. Add a descriptive alt attribute to the promo banner img in the header of layout.html.
2. Mark the banner as decorative by giving the img an empty alt attribute in layout.html, which suits a purely visual banner.
3. Remove the promo banner img from the header in layout.html until the banner asset and its text exist.

**How to reply**

Reply with a mention of Downstream followed by `fix it` to apply option 1, or `fix option N` for another option. Downstream commits the change on a new branch, opens a merge request for it against the original branch, and re-runs the page check on it. It never merges.

title: [Downstream] frontend: missing asset /static/promo-banner.png
description:
Downstream's frontend check on !6 found this on the head build (f2ba5450482c) and not on the base build (7f2473276ae8). Started by @AlphaTechini.

**Where it shows up**

- `home_shows_header`: `/static/promo-banner.png` answered 404
- `explore_shows_header`: `/static/promo-banner.png` answered 404
- `repo_page_shows_header`: `/static/promo-banner.png` answered 404

Pages were rendered in happy-dom with the app's own JavaScript, three times: base twice, then head. A check that moved between the two base runs is withheld, not reported here.

**Frontend files changed**

- `internal/web/templates/layout.html`

Not checked: color-contrast, visual layout, real paint/CPU timing.

**Likely cause**

Likely the img in the header of layout.html points at a promo banner file under the static path that does not exist, and the app serves its static files under a different prefix, so the request answers not found.

**Fix options**

1. Remove the promo banner img from the header in layout.html until the image file is added to the repository.
2. Point the img src in layout.html at an asset that already exists under the static prefix the app serves, such as the existing favicon file.
3. Add the promo banner image file to the static directory and change the img src in layout.html to the served static prefix.

**How to reply**

Reply with a mention of Downstream followed by `fix it` to apply option 1, or `fix option N` for another option. Downstream commits the change on a new branch, opens a merge request for it against the original branch, and re-runs the page check on it. It never merges.
